name: four-repo
context: Repo layout for Loom. Signpost, schema, movers, and renderers as separate repos.
chose: Four tethered repos. loom holds no code. loom-warp holds the schema. loom-shuttle holds movers. loom-weave holds renderers.
consequences: First pull request is not a thread.json at loom root. Cross-repo pointers remain OPEN.
